name: linux-permission-inspector
purpose: Decode Unix permission bits and flag world-writable files.
limitations: Decodes supplied metadata; does not inspect ACLs, ownership, or effective permissions.

name: disk-capacity-planner
purpose: Calculate filesystem capacity headroom before a maintenance change.
limitations: Uses a static snapshot; filesystem reserved blocks and growth rates are not collected.

name: memory-pressure-checker
purpose: Summarize a Linux meminfo snapshot without confusing cached memory with unavailable memory.
limitations: Accepts Linux meminfo text; pressure percentage is a capacity indicator, not Linux PSI.

name: process-snapshot-sorter
purpose: Rank a supplied process snapshot by CPU consumption.
limitations: Does not sample live processes; CPU percentages depend on the upstream collection interval.

name: inode-usage-checker
purpose: Identify inode exhaustion separately from byte capacity.
limitations: Filesystems without a fixed inode capacity require different interpretation.

name: mount-option-auditor
purpose: Compare mount options with an explicit expected hardening policy.
limitations: Policy is supplied per mount; applying noexec or other flags can break applications and is not performed.

name: path-entry-auditor
purpose: Detect PATH entries that depend on the working directory.
limitations: Does not check directory ownership, symlinks, or write permissions.

name: system-load-analyzer
purpose: Normalize load averages against a supplied CPU count.
limitations: Linux load includes uninterruptible tasks; this is not a CPU utilization measurement.

name: uid-collision-detector
purpose: Find account names sharing a numeric UID in passwd-format data.
limitations: Some shared UIDs are intentional; review identity sources and policy before changing accounts.

name: file-integrity-manifest
purpose: Generate deterministic SHA-256 hashes for supplied text file contents.
limitations: UTF-8 text input only; hashes prove content equality, not authenticity or trusted provenance.

name: log-level-counter
purpose: Count explicit severity tokens in text logs.
limitations: Matches the first uppercase token; structured logging avoids ambiguous text classification.

name: cron-field-validator
purpose: Validate a deliberately restricted five-field cron schedule.
limitations: Does not support ranges, steps, lists, macros, timezone semantics, or calendar feasibility.

name: directory-size-summary
purpose: Group collected file sizes by top-level relative directory.
limitations: Uses a supplied file inventory; sparse allocation, hard links, and compression are not modeled.

name: environment-variable-auditor
purpose: Check required environment variable names without printing secret values.
limitations: Input may contain secrets; use protected files and avoid recording request bodies.

name: service-port-inventory
purpose: Find services that claim the same transport protocol and port.
limitations: Binding conflicts also depend on addresses, namespaces, and reuse settings; these are not modeled.

name: cidr-overlap-checker
purpose: Find overlapping IP networks in a proposed address inventory.
limitations: Compares CIDRs only; does not read routes, peering relationships, or cloud accounts.

name: subnet-capacity-calculator
purpose: Calculate IPv4 address capacity with explicit provider reservations.
limitations: Reservation count is user supplied; point-to-point and provider-specific rules differ.

name: dns-record-linter
purpose: Validate a small DNS inventory for address family and TTL consistency.
limitations: Does not resolve DNS or validate CNAME coexistence, DNSSEC, TXT data, or authority.

name: http-access-log-summary
purpose: Summarize structured HTTP request records by status class and route.
limitations: Consumes normalized records, not raw combined-log-format lines; route cardinality must be controlled.

name: tls-expiry-planner
purpose: Calculate a certificate renewal deadline relative to an explicit evaluation time.
limitations: Uses supplied expiry metadata; does not perform a TLS handshake or inspect certificate trust.

name: latency-percentile-calculator
purpose: Compute nearest-rank latency percentiles from observed samples.
limitations: Nearest-rank estimates from small samples are coarse; do not average these percentiles across hosts.

name: tcp-retry-budget
purpose: Estimate the maximum configured connection-attempt time including exponential retry delays.
limitations: A model rather than a network probe; excludes DNS, scheduling, jitter, and application processing.

name: route-longest-prefix
purpose: Select the most specific matching route for an IP destination.
limitations: Does not model metrics, policy routing, equal-cost multipath, or interface state.

name: nginx-upstream-checker
purpose: Review a normalized upstream pool for duplicate endpoints and traffic weights.
limitations: Reads normalized JSON, not nginx syntax; failover, max_fails, and passive health behavior are outside scope.

name: ip-allowlist-evaluator
purpose: Evaluate whether supplied client addresses belong to an explicit CIDR allowlist.
limitations: An offline membership check; it does not configure a firewall or establish client identity.

name: port-range-merger
purpose: Collapse overlapping or adjacent port ranges into a minimal equivalent list.
limitations: Merge only ranges with the same protocol, direction, and policy action.

name: url-health-manifest
purpose: Review health-check URLs for schemes, embedded credentials, and duplicates.
limitations: Does not make requests or resolve hosts. A syntactically valid URL is not necessarily reachable or trusted.

name: json-log-filter
purpose: Filter JSON log records with exact field matching and a bounded result count.
limitations: In-memory exact matching only; input and output logs may contain sensitive information.

name: syslog-severity-summary
purpose: Decode syslog priority numbers into facility and severity counts.
limitations: Uses numeric syslog priority values; does not parse timestamps, hostnames, or transport framing.

name: network-throughput-estimator
purpose: Calculate observed bit rate from cumulative byte counters.
limitations: Assumes one monotonic counter without wraparound; reported rate depends on sampling accuracy.

name: http-status-budget
purpose: Calculate a request failure ratio using an explicit server-error classification.
limitations: Counts only 5xx as failures; service-specific availability may classify timeouts and some 4xx differently.

name: config-drift-detector
purpose: Compare desired and observed configuration values without modifying hosts.
limitations: Compares top-level keys; values may contain secrets, so review input and output handling.

name: backup-retention-planner
purpose: Select dated backups to retain under a count-based policy.
limitations: Produces a plan only; backup chains, legal retention, immutability, and restore tests require separate checks.

name: rotation-size-planner
purpose: Estimate storage consumed by rotated logs and an active file.
limitations: Assumes equally sized rotations; compression ratios and log growth vary. No files are rotated or removed.

name: ssh-policy-auditor
purpose: Check selected sshd directives against an explicit expected policy.
limitations: A restricted text review; use sshd -T with connection criteria for effective production settings.

name: sudo-policy-linter
purpose: Flag broad passwordless sudo rules for manual review.
limitations: Not a sudoers parser or security proof. Validate syntax with visudo and review aliases and includes separately.

name: ansible-inventory-auditor
purpose: Find hosts without an owner group in a normalized inventory.
limitations: Uses a flat JSON projection; Ansible child groups, patterns, and variable precedence are not evaluated.

name: systemd-unit-linter
purpose: Review selected service-unit settings for predictable operation.
limitations: Restricted INI subset only; repeated directives and systemd override semantics require systemd-analyze verify.

name: package-pin-auditor
purpose: Find package requirements missing an exact version in a normalized package list.
limitations: Checks normalized version strings, not package-manager resolution or vulnerability status.

name: secret-redaction-filter
purpose: Redact values beneath explicitly sensitive JSON key names.
limitations: Exact key matching only; secrets embedded in free text or unexpected fields will remain.

name: configuration-overlay-merge
purpose: Merge configuration objects with explicit recursive object and replacement-list behavior.
limitations: Lists and nulls replace existing values; no schema validation, variable expansion, or secret resolution is performed.

name: backup-manifest-verifier
purpose: Compare an expected checksum manifest against observed checksum metadata.
limitations: Compares supplied checksum strings; it does not independently read backups or validate the trusted manifest.

name: maintenance-window-planner
purpose: Find conflicting UTC maintenance intervals.
limitations: Treats intervals as half-open; does not model recurrence, business calendars, or service dependency exceptions.

name: certificate-inventory-reporter
purpose: Group certificate inventory entries by owner and identify missing ownership.
limitations: Ownership reporting only; issuance, revocation, trust chains, and expiry verification are separate tasks.

name: least-privilege-file-auditor
purpose: Review file modes against an expected permission ceiling.
limitations: Does not evaluate ACLs, capabilities, mount policies, ownership, or required minimum permissions.

name: change-plan-risk-checker
purpose: Flag destructive changes to stateful resources for review.
limitations: A review aid rather than an approval system; statefulness must be identified accurately by the caller.

name: ansible-task-tag-auditor
purpose: Review normalized Ansible task metadata for operational tags.
limitations: Accepts expanded task metadata; does not resolve inherited tags, includes, roles, or special Ansible tags.

name: dockerfile-policy-checker
purpose: Review a Dockerfile for an explicit runtime user, health check, and base image tag.
limitations: A line-oriented review only; it does not resolve build stages, ARGs, inherited health checks, or Dockerfile continuations.

name: compose-port-auditor
purpose: Find Compose published ports exposed on wildcard addresses.
limitations: Uses expanded Compose JSON port objects; host firewall policy and Docker networking still affect reachability.

name: container-resource-planner
purpose: Compare aggregate container reservations with a host capacity budget.
limitations: A sum of supplied reservations; ignores host overhead, noisy neighbors, burst capacity, and placement constraints.

name: image-tag-policy-checker
purpose: Distinguish digest-pinned images from mutable tags.
limitations: Digest syntax does not prove an image exists, is signed, or is free from vulnerabilities.

name: healthcheck-timing-calculator
purpose: Model failure detection for a stated fixed-start-interval health-check schedule.
limitations: An idealized fixed-start schedule; Docker and orchestrators can schedule checks differently, so measure real detection time.

name: ci-job-dependency-checker
purpose: Topologically group CI jobs and detect unknown dependencies or cycles.
limitations: Models static dependencies only; conditions, matrices, reusable workflows, and concurrency controls are not evaluated.

name: artifact-checksum-verifier
purpose: Verify UTF-8 artifact content against an expected SHA-256 digest.
limitations: Text artifacts only; trust in the expected digest must come from a separate authenticated source.

name: build-context-auditor
purpose: Identify potentially sensitive files in a supplied container build-context inventory.
limitations: Uses simple fnmatch rules, not full dockerignore semantics; file content and embedded secrets are not scanned.

name: environment-parity-checker
purpose: Compare selected configuration keys between two deployment environments.
limitations: Does not print values; intentionally different environment settings should be excluded explicitly.

name: deployment-wave-planner
purpose: Split a defined deployment order into bounded rollout waves.
limitations: Uses caller-supplied order; it does not infer dependency safety or perform deployments.

name: container-log-normalizer
purpose: Normalize selected structured container log fields into a stable record shape.
limitations: Consumes JSON records; multiline joining, trace correlation, redaction, and timestamp inference are outside scope.

name: image-layer-budget
purpose: Review image-layer sizes against a supplied storage budget.
limitations: Compressed and unpacked sizes differ; shared layers and registry deduplication are not modeled.

name: registry-reference-parser
purpose: Split an explicit registry image reference into repository, tag, and digest fields.
limitations: Parses a restricted reference shape; it does not validate the complete OCI name grammar or contact a registry.

name: ci-matrix-expander
purpose: Expand a bounded Cartesian test matrix from named dimensions.
limitations: Does not evaluate include/exclude expressions or CI provider limits beyond the local combination cap.

name: release-manifest-validator
purpose: Check a normalized release manifest for unique services and immutable image digests.
limitations: Checks manifest structure only; digest existence, signatures, compatibility, and deployment approval are separate concerns.

name: readiness-gate-evaluator
purpose: Evaluate named readiness checks against success and latency criteria.
limitations: Evaluates supplied observations; no probes are executed and readiness is not an uptime guarantee.

name: terraform-plan-risk-auditor
purpose: Summarize destructive actions from Terraform plan JSON.
limitations: Consumes plan JSON; does not evaluate unknown values, sensitive data, policy exceptions, or apply resources.

name: aws-security-group-auditor
purpose: Flag Internet-wide rules exposing SSH, RDP, or all IP protocols.
limitations: Static ingress review; routing, NACLs, IPv6 prefix lists, security group references, and reachability are not evaluated.

name: cloud-tag-compliance
purpose: Find missing ownership and cost allocation tags in resource inventory.
limitations: Uses normalized inventory; tagging support, inherited tags, and policy exceptions vary by resource type.

name: cloud-resource-cost-estimator
purpose: Estimate usage-based cost using rates supplied by the caller.
limitations: No live prices or billing guarantees; excludes taxes, discounts, transfer, storage, and other charges unless supplied explicitly.

name: vpc-address-planner
purpose: Allocate a bounded number of equal-size subnets from a parent IPv4 network.
limitations: Does not consult existing allocations or provider constraints; validate against the organization IPAM system.

name: iam-wildcard-auditor
purpose: Identify wildcard Allow statements requiring an IAM policy review.
limitations: Not an IAM authorization evaluator; conditions, Deny statements, SCPs, permission boundaries, and resource policies can alter effective access.

name: s3-public-access-checker
purpose: Review the four S3 Public Access Block settings in supplied bucket metadata.
limitations: Reports settings only, not effective public access. Account-level blocks, ACLs, policies, and access points require separate inspection.

name: terraform-output-redactor
purpose: Redact outputs marked sensitive in Terraform output JSON.
limitations: Relies on correct sensitive metadata; misclassified secrets remain visible and input must be protected.

name: cloud-quota-headroom
purpose: Calculate quota usage and flag insufficient capacity for planned additions.
limitations: Uses a static regional/account snapshot; quota increases, resource release timing, and service limits are not requested.

name: availability-zone-distributor
purpose: Distribute a desired replica count evenly across supplied zones.
limitations: A desired distribution, not a placement scheduler; ignores zonal capacity, stateful topology, and disruption budgets.

name: cloud-budget-forecast
purpose: Extrapolate period spend using elapsed-day average cost.
limitations: Straight-line projection only; does not model credits, seasonality, billing delay, or commitments.

name: ebs-snapshot-retention
purpose: Plan count-based snapshot retention independently for each volume.
limitations: No AWS calls or deletions; AMI dependencies, incomplete snapshots, backup policies, and compliance locks need independent review.

name: terraform-dependency-graph
purpose: Build reverse dependencies from a normalized resource dependency inventory.
limitations: Consumes a normalized graph, not HCL or Terraform graph output; implicit references and cycles require other checks.

name: cloud-idle-resource-finder
purpose: Find resource observations below a caller-defined utilization threshold.
limitations: Low CPU alone does not prove a resource is unused. Check traffic, memory, duty cycle, ownership, and recovery roles.

name: network-egress-cost-planner
purpose: Estimate transfer cost from explicitly priced network flows.
limitations: Rates are example inputs, not live provider prices. Tiers, free allowances, direction, and region affect billing.

name: slo-error-budget-calculator
purpose: Calculate a request-based error budget and remaining allowance.
limitations: Assumes valid events and good/bad classification already defined; fractional budgets are expected with ratio objectives.

name: burn-rate-alert-evaluator
purpose: Evaluate paired error-ratio windows against one burn-rate threshold.
limitations: Requires pre-aggregated windows; no traffic floor, missing-data policy, paging integration, or recording-rule evaluation is implemented.

name: incident-timeline-checker
purpose: Validate incident event ordering and summarize observed elapsed time.
limitations: Examples are exercises, not production incident claims. Event span alone is not necessarily customer-impact duration.

name: alert-deduplication-tool
purpose: Group alerts by a caller-selected identity label set.
limitations: An offline grouping exercise; production alert grouping must preserve routing boundaries and incident semantics.

name: runbook-coverage-auditor
purpose: Find services missing operational ownership or a runbook URL.
limitations: Presence checks only; does not validate URL reachability, ownership currency, or runbook effectiveness.

name: oncall-handoff-builder
purpose: Assemble an open-item handoff from normalized operational records.
limitations: Builds a draft from provided facts only; it does not send messages, contact on-call staff, or invent incidents.

name: recovery-time-analyzer
purpose: Compare recorded recovery drill durations with a stated recovery-time target.
limitations: Uses completed drill observations; sample results do not prove a production RTO or include data-loss measurement.

name: capacity-forecast-tool
purpose: Extrapolate resource exhaustion from two dated usage observations.
limitations: A two-point linear projection with no confidence interval; validate trends and planned changes before buying capacity.

name: prometheus-label-cardinality
purpose: Estimate series cardinality from independent label value inventories.
limitations: Assumes a complete Cartesian product and one series per combination; histograms and correlated labels change the estimate.

name: prometheus-textfile-validator
purpose: Validate a deliberately small unlabeled Prometheus textfile subset.
limitations: Supports unlabeled finite numeric samples only; labels, timestamps, histograms, exemplars, and special values are rejected.

name: prometheus-alert-rule-linter
purpose: Review normalized alert rules for names, expressions, ownership, and a hold duration.
limitations: Does not parse PromQL or replace promtool check rules. Compound and zero durations are intentionally outside this subset.

name: retry-storm-simulator
purpose: Model worst-case request amplification when every client exhausts retries.
limitations: A worst-case count model; no requests are sent. Backoff, jitter, partial success, and time overlap are not simulated.

name: chaos-experiment-planner
purpose: Review a lab failure-exercise proposal for blast-radius and stop-condition metadata.
limitations: Metadata review only; a passing result is not authorization or proof of safety. No fault is injected.

name: service-dependency-impact
purpose: Find services transitively dependent on a failed component.
limitations: Graph reachability indicates potential impact; caches, redundancy, fallbacks, and partial degradation require runtime evidence.

name: postmortem-action-tracker
purpose: Identify overdue open follow-up actions relative to an explicit date.
limitations: Example actions are exercises. The tool does not create issues, assign owners, or verify completion evidence.
